subject: Final closure: bridge readiness + light smoke certification
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Tony Salazar <tony@acme.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Final closure: bridge readiness + light smoke certification

Tony / ACME ops team —

Thanks again for running the pre-cutover validation this morning. Per our call, we want to close the loop on the remaining light-smoke checklist and handoff evidence so Procurement can finish the order and we can flip the traffic next week. Key asks in this note:

- Schedule: confirm a 30-minute quiet window on Tuesday 2027-12-21 02:00–02:30 UTC for the final switch.
- Smoke checklist: we ran an abbreviated KV priming and prefilling test; please review the attached kv-prime-checklist.csv and the runbook we referenced (runbook_v1.3.pdf).
- Evidence: when you’ve run the post-deploy probes, please upload the telemetry snapshot to the shared Drive link and return the small handoff_evidence.zip (see related_links).

From our side:
- We will be on the bridge 30 minutes before the window and will hold an ops bridge until +60m after the switch.
- Laura will own telemetry validation and SLA smoke thresholds. Rishi will monitor routing and fallback lanes.

Can you confirm the quiet window + that the ACME side will run the three probes in section 2 of the runbook? If anything blocks the timeline we should escalate by EOD Monday.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
Attachments: runbook_v1.3.pdf (doc), kv-prime-checklist.csv (spreadsheet)
From: Tony Salazar <tony@acme.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-eng@acme.com
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final closure: bridge readiness + light smoke certification

Kimberly —

Thanks, confirmed. Quiet window on 2027-12-21 02:00–02:30 UTC works for ACME. Our infra lead (ops-eng) will run the three probes in section 2 and post results to the Drive link immediately after. A couple of quick notes:

- We see intermittent 503s under the staged load test at 10rps — devs are looking but we can still proceed with the light smoke if you accept the risk.
- We’ll attach the probe output and a small traces bundle (hand-off evidence) to the Drive folder.

I’ll also CC Procurement on this thread so they can reconcile the final invoice and DocuSign certs.

—Tony
Tony Salazar
Head of Infrastructure, Acme Corp
Attachments referenced: handoff_evidence.zip
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Tony Salazar <tony@acme.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 19 Dec 2027 11:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final closure: bridge readiness + light smoke certification

Tony / Kim —

I started a quick pass on the telemetry thresholds this morning. Notes below from the abbreviated smoke:

- KV warmup: prefixes primed successfully for the 90% bucket; 10% of keys showed >250ms cold miss. See kv-prime-checklist.csv row 4 for the breakdown.
- Latency: tail P99 for the test path spiked to 320ms under the staged 10rps test Tony mentioned (we would typically expect <250ms in the steady state).
- Error rate: 503 incidents correspond with a known ALB retry bug; Rishi, can you confirm the routing fallback config will bypass the affected ALB?

Suggested mitigations for the switch:
- Hold the door: if ACME wants to reduce risk, compress the quiet window to 02:05–02:20 UTC and throttle ingress to 5rps initially while we observe stats for 10m.
- Fallback readiness: confirm a fallback lane (regional model variant) is registered in the smart-router with automatic failover.

If Tony confirms they are comfortable with the 5rps warmup we can sign off here; otherwise we can keep the 30m window but prepare the rollback path.

Laura Bennett
Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Tony Salazar <tony@acme.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2027 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final closure: bridge readiness + light smoke certification

All —

Quick operational update from the routing side:

- Confirmed: fallback lane is configured to route to the regional variant (rgn-us-west-2-small) and health-checks are green. Failover policy is set to 70% latency breach OR 5xx >= 1% over 1m.
- ALB issue: engineering pushed a permanent fix to the ALB retry handler last night; given the timing we recommend proceeding with a conservative ramp (Laura's suggestion): 02:05–02:20 UTC, start at 2rps for 5 minutes, then 5rps for 10 minutes, observe, then stretch to 10rps if stable.

Procurement — please confirm DocuSign signature is ready; I see an unsigned envelope (DOCUSIGN-ABC-12345) that needs completion to finalize billing.

If nobody objects by 13:00 PST I will mark this thread as green and we proceed with the planned quiet window.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Engineering Lead, Infrastructure Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachments: handoff_evidence.zip (from ACME), runbook_v1.3.pdf (reference)
